pieces.title: HCP leave-behind: Think ATTR-CM in heart failure
pieces.body: VYNDAQEL and VYNDAMAX are indicated for the treatment of the cardiomyopathy of wild-type or hereditary transthyretin-mediated amyloidosis (ATTR-CM) in adults to reduce cardiovascular mortality and cardiovascular-related hospitalization. In the 30-month placebo-controlled trial (n=441), pooled VYNDAQEL showed a 30% relative reduction in the risk of all-cause death (HR 0.70, 95% CI 0.51 to 0.96) and a 32% reduction in the risk of cardiovascular-related hospitalization (relative risk ratio 0.68). Results consistently favored VYNDAQEL across subgroups except for cardiovascular-related hospitalization frequency in NYHA Class III patients. VYNDAMAX is one 61 mg capsule once daily. IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION, shown at equal size: Based on animal studies, VYNDAQEL and VYNDAMAX may cause fetal harm; advise pregnant women of the potential risk. Adverse event frequency was similar to placebo; 7% (80 mg), 6% (20 mg) and 6% (placebo) discontinued for an adverse event. There are no contraindications. No comparison with other ATTR-CM medicines is made because no head-to-head trial supports one. See full Prescribing Information.

return.math: 1) Budget moved: $80.3M a year x 2 = $160.6M. 2) Ibrance revenue lost from ending promotion: 1% of annualized U.S. revenue [assumption] = $26.8M a year x 2 = $53.6M, x (1 - 25.9% cost of sales [PFE:10q_2026Q2.md p.39]) = $39.7M lost contribution. 3) Net operating income freed = $160.6M - $39.7M = $120.9M, reported as about $120M, before any return the redeployed money earns in atirmociclib or Vyndaqel.

cites.quote: But the hit on us is very small. The NPV is very small because it's really a few months of exclusivity.
cites.label: Pfizer 2025Q2 earnings call (third_party), p. 13
cites.speaker: Albert Bourla

assumptions: [assumption] U.S. Ibrance promotion = 3% of U.S. revenue: Pfizer does not disclose brand-level SI&A
[assumption] 1% revenue loss from ending promotion of a drug that faces a 50% Medicare price cut and generic entry in the same year
[assumption] the redeployed funds are not double counted with PFE-m01's $200M

evidence.lands_because: Management already treats Ibrance's 2027 hit as small (CEO: 'The NPV is very small because it's really a few months of exclusivity', 2025Q2 call p.13) and is steering breast cancer toward atirmociclib, with an adjuvant study set to start by end 2026 [2026Q2 call p.13]. Investors reward cost discipline that funds growth inside existing guidance.
evidence.can_tell: Timing of the 2027 price and patent events and management's stated pivot.
evidence.cannot_tell: Actual Ibrance promotional spend, how much demand promotion still sustains (U.S. Q2 2026 Ibrance grew 2% to $707M), and how investors would value the shift; no brand-level cost data is indexed.
